🔥 textual-web | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To make Textual-based terminal applications and raw terminals accessible and shareable through a web browser interface.
✨ Key Features: • Publish Textual apps and terminals on the web • Run TUIs in a browser • Generate public URLs for apps and terminals • Serve multiple apps and terminals via configuration • Support for serving raw terminals with optional commands
📖 Summary: Textual Web allows users to run Textual applications and terminals directly in their web browser. It acts as a bridge, making TUIs accessible remotely and shareable via public URLs, simplifying the deployment and access of terminal-based applications.
